H_protocol: H1 literal own-plane act; H2 amplified actual disposition/reaction; H3 requires actual behavior-dependent local punchline commitment, not staging, source doubt or a quota. No selected premise supplies a warranted primary H3. H4 is used for the explicit damage/boat comparisons, not fantasy, magical selectivity, game abstractions or all idioms.
L_protocol: L0 portable mechanism; L1 material wording/rhythm; L2 material register/pragmatics; L3 central Japanese form requiring reconstruction/annotation. The kindness/lewdness correction and cross-speaker word completion warrant L3. Other scripts, idioms and stored Japanese fragments do not automatically do so.
